title: FIFA世界杯中场秀：效仿超级碗打造全球娱乐盛宴
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We've seen halftime shows in the NBA in college with marching bands and of course at the Super Bowl But never in the World Cup until now
segments.zh: 我们见过NBA和大学橄榄球赛的中场秀，当然还有超级碗，但世界杯从未有过，直到现在。

segments.en: I'm Randall Williams a sports business reporter at Bloomberg News and I'm taking you inside the world's biggest sporting events Today we are headed to the most watch showdown on earth the FIFA World Cup
segments.zh: 我是彭博新闻的体育商业记者兰德尔·威廉姆斯，带你走进全球最大体育赛事。今天我们去往地球上最受瞩目的对决：国际足联世界杯。

segments.en: This year the FIFA World Cup has something completely different a halftime show
segments.zh: 今年世界杯有了全新元素：中场秀。

segments.en: That's right. FIFA is pulling a page straight out of the NFL Super Bowl But in turning the World Cup final intermission into a full-scale entertainment spectacle
segments.zh: 没错，国际足联借鉴了NFL超级碗的做法，将世界杯决赛的中场休息打造成一场完整的娱乐盛宴。

segments.en: FIFA is brought on global citizen with the help of Cole plays Chris Martin to find the right performers and the star power is massive Shakira Madonna BTS plus Justin Bieber will brace the stage and they'll be supported by some familiar faces as well
segments.zh: 国际足联携手Global Citizen，在酷玩乐队克里斯·马丁的帮助下挑选表演者，阵容强大：夏奇拉、麦当娜、防弹少年团，还有贾斯汀·比伯将登台，一些熟悉面孔也会助阵。

segments.en: Elmo, Kermit the Frog and other iconic characters from Sesame Street and the Muppets will join the trio I know it sounds very random, but the reality is FIFA is trying to turn this show into a cultural moment will all remember
segments.zh: 艾摩、青蛙柯密特等《芝麻街》和《布偶秀》的经典角色将加入。我知道听起来很随机，但国际足联正试图让这场秀成为我们都会记住的文化时刻。

segments.en: I'm so excited. I have been wanting to see Justin Bieber for so long and now I finally get to This group could have one of the most watched musical performances of all time
segments.zh: 我太兴奋了，一直想看贾斯汀·比伯，现在终于能看到了。这个组合可能会创造史上观看人数最多的音乐表演之一。

segments.en: We all know and love Elmo and Kermit But Madonna Shakira BTS and Bieber could have one of the most watched musical performances of all time
segments.zh: 我们都熟悉并喜爱艾摩和柯密特，但麦当娜、夏奇拉、防弹少年团和比伯的组合可能创造史上观看人数最多的音乐表演之一。

segments.en: The group of musicians have been buying for over 300 million monthly listeners on Spotify
segments.zh: 这些音乐人在Spotify上的月听众合计超过3亿。
